<?php
namespace IntCastWrapper256;
use const E_WARNING as Base256;
use const E_ERROR as One256;
function warning256($errno, $message, $file, $line) {
    global $x256;
    echo 'warning:', $message, '|';
    defaults256(2);
    $x256 = 3.5;
}
function defaults256(int $first, int &$integer = (int)((+(-(float)(+(Base256 === One256)))) + 3.5), int $last = 7) {
    echo 'body:', $first, ':', $integer, ':', $last, '|';
    $integer = 9;
}
\set_error_handler('IntCastWrapper256\\warning256');
$x256 = 1.5;
$last256 = 8;
defaults256(last: $last256, first: $x256);
echo 'outer:x=', $x256, '|';
purpose: Canonical (int) of actual phase-aware fraction3.5 caches raw PINT3 through imported ENV, named holes, warning reentry and private BYREF reception; mutation leaves its raw cache unchanged.
